rules: One global Ingredient Master for all meal categories.
Do not create a second ingredient database in Calyra, Lovable or Supabase.
Do not invent or silently rename canonical ingredients.
Aliases map source strings to approved canonical identities.
Components are prepared recipe elements and are separate from simple ingredients.
LF means lactose-free and is a variant/product attribute, not a separate master.
GF is separate only where explicitly approved as a product identity.
WEGE substitutions remain recipe-level variant/substitution logic.
Do not assign quantities, units, calories, nutrition, allergens or IDs at this identity stage.
koncentrat pomidorowy is canonical for earlier przecier pomidorowy occurrences.
Ambiguous generic items must not be forced into a master without context.
tłuszcz kokosowy maps to olej kokosowy and is not a separate canonical identity.
serek kanapkowy z oliwkami is a simple ready-made spread cheese; serek z oliwkami is an alias, not a component.
polędwica sopocka is canonical; polędwica kostka maps to it.
buraczki ćwikła is the approved Polish canonical simple name and is separate from the component sałatka z buraczków.
